text: You just watched the Moon vanish. Here's what happens next.
You saw it late. Its light takes over a second to reach you.
If it's high tide the sea starts to sink away from the dock.
But the tides don't stop. The Sun still pulls them at less than half the size.
Tonight is over a hundred times darker than a full moon night.
Baby sea turtles hatch and can't find the sea.
On the reef the corals wait to lay their eggs on a full moon that never comes.
Over millions of years Earth's tilt could swing as far as eighty five degrees.
Then some places would hardly ever see the Sun.
Tag a night owl and subscribe. And that's what happens if the Moon disappears.
